accessibility.evidence: Keyboard Tab reached the compact Repositories navigation link in logical order with a computed 2px solid visible outline; compact New conversation and route links computed to 44px. responsive.evidence: At emulated 390x844, clientWidth and scrollWidth were both 390px, the workspace resolved to one 390px column, and sidebar/inspector were hidden. The recorded compact artifact at 500x844 also has no clipped controls or horizontal overflow.

loading.evidence: Source-review check: existing loading copy and stable shell containers were unchanged by this CSS/branding-only modernization.

empty.evidence: Rendered check: both artifacts show the empty Ask workspace retaining the primary composer and direct setup actions.

error.evidence: Source-review check: semantic error/retry DOM and danger token usage were unchanged; this state was not represented in the two rendered artifacts.

partial.evidence: Rendered check: the sample setup surface shows available local model discovery while GitHub setup remains unavailable, without hiding either state.

success.evidence: Source-review check: success labels remain textual and now use the mint semantic token; a completed-success fixture was not included in the rendered artifacts.

permission.evidence: Rendered check: the setup surface names the secure-storage boundary and leaves the next safe setup action visible.
